auditPolicy.scope: all unique fish-domain pairs under complete synthetic tank inputs
auditPolicy.note: The fixed large tank is a deterministic audit fixture, not a husbandry recommendation. Pair verdict distribution is diagnostic; with complete tank inputs the hard invariants are fully-informed UNKNOWN = 0, internal missing_species_fact/system_gap UNKNOWN = 0, and every remaining UNKNOWN must be unresolved identity or genuinely insufficient public evidence.

userPathExposure.scope: uniform unique-pair exposure across species currently selectable in the fish Compatibility calculator
userPathExposure.note: uniformUnknownRatePct is a catalog-pair stress metric, not observed user traffic probability. Unsupported non-fish livestock are excluded from the calculator because the current deterministic domain is explicitly fish-only.

leverageQueues.policy: Prioritize reviewed evidence work by actual UNKNOWN-pair impact. affectedUnknownPairs means the taxon participates in that many current UNKNOWN pairs; it is not a guarantee that resolving the taxon alone will unlock every pair because the opposite species or non-core facts can remain blocking.
